tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Read one issue, its fields, and the lease held on it.

tools.name: get_task_history
tools.description: Read the comment history of one issue, with secrets redacted.

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: List coordination issues and the lease each one currently holds.

tools.name: handoff_task
tools.description: Open a handoff issue for another role and release the source lease. It does not grant access.

tools.name: post_progress
tools.description: Post a progress comment. The caller must hold the live lease.

tools.name: release_task
tools.description: Release the caller's lease. status:done needs evidence, and a linked pull request must be merged and reviewed. A required pull request with no link is refused.

tools.name: renew_lease
tools.description: Renew the caller's live lease. The original claim comment id stays.

tools.name: request_review
tools.description: Post one @codex review on an open pull request. Closed pulls, a repeat of the same head, and a fourth round are refused.
